scope.how_the_cover_is_built: One whole-suite run under COVERAGE_CORE=ctrace and --cov-context=test tags each line with the case that ran it. A greedy choice then adds the test file that gains the most mutation lines for each second, until the cover runs every mutation line any case runs. The default coverage core of Python 3.14 records almost no context, and a cover built on it names too few test files.
